purpose: Close the learning prototype with a reproducible, source-grounded final evaluation, not certify production readiness.
dataset_note: Assistant-authored project-specific Korean questions. Not a public benchmark, random population sample, or human-certified test set.
novelty: Answerable questions should use 24 distinct notice IDs absent from pre-existing eval JSON/JSONL. Corpus documents remain indexed; this is evaluation-source separation, not training-data exclusion. Near-duplicate texts and topic overlap may remain.

generation.temperature: SDK/model default, not a reproducibility guarantee

metrics.hit_at_k: Fraction of the 24 answerable questions with at least one complete predeclared body-and-source match in the first k evidence bundles, k=1,3,5. This is not exhaustive document recall.
metrics.mrr_at_5: Mean reciprocal rank of the first complete labeled evidence bundle across all 24 answerable questions; absent in top five contributes zero.
metrics.answer_accuracy: Assistant source review: correct and complete answer under the predeclared rubric, divided by all 24 answerable questions. Abstention, incomplete answer, wrong conditions, and API failure count as unsuccessful. Report missing reviews separately.
metrics.answer_coverage: Number of answerable questions receiving status answered divided by 24; pair with answer accuracy so abstention cannot inflate results.
metrics.selective_accuracy: Correct complete answers divided by answered answerable questions; null if none answered. Secondary metric only.
metrics.claim_support: Fraction of generated claims fully supported by the actual cited bodies, determined by assistant source comparison. Check every claim, including extra claims. No claims means null, not 100%. This is not a human-certified RAGAS score.
metrics.citation_validity: All cited IDs belong to the actually supplied source registry; structural check only, not semantic correctness.
metrics.behavior_accuracy: Correct behavior under each fixed rubric divided by all 8 non-answerable/underspecified/adversarial cases. Correct status alone does not establish correct behavior.
metrics.performance: Report one-time model/index loading separately, then warm retrieval including query embedding and generation wall time p50/p95. Total measured request time excludes one-time setup and offline benchmark baseline work. Small single-run timing sample, not an SLA.
metrics.usage: Sum SDK-reported input/output/total usage including returned retry responses, with missing-field and failed-call limitations explicit. E5 estimates are not billed Gemini tokens; do not estimate money without current pricing.

reference_targets.meaning: Predeclared learning-prototype reference targets, not empirically calibrated deployment gates. Report unmet targets without tuning this benchmark away.

review_rules: Record semantic judgments separately from raw automatic results; do not rewrite labels or original reports after seeing answers.
A valid alternate source or synonymous expression may be accepted only with recorded source evidence and rationale, separately from strict automatic retrieval/phrase scores.
Failure taxonomy: retrieval miss, incomplete context, wrong generation, incomplete answer, wrong behavior, label limitation, provider error. More than one may apply.
Assistant reviewers are not human/user approval. Preserve claim-level reasons and the exact reviewed report SHA-256.
Do not improve production retrieval, prompting, or embedding after final results within this release. Any later tuning requires a new version and a fresh untouched test.
Preserve previous results and dirty user work. No deployment, publication, or git commit is implied by closing this prototype.
